a-better-tomorrow.body:
If |*Miles Morales| is within |!range| 2 of an allied |*Ms. Marvel (Normal)|,
both characters may spend 2 |!power| each to play this card.|\|
|*Ms. Marvel (Normal)| transforms into |*Ms. Marvel (Embiggened)|. When resolving this transformation,
place |*Ms. Marvel (Embiggened)| within |!range| 3 instead of |!range| 1.
Then place |*Miles Morales| within |!range| 1 of |*Ms. Marvel (Embiggened)|.

a-force-assemble.body:
An |*A-Force| character may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
When an allied character is defending against an attack this round,
add 1 die to the defense roll for each other allied |*A-Force| character
within |!range| 2 of that character.

a-new-age.body:
|*Jim Hammond| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Each enemy character within |!range| 3 of |*Jim Hammond| gains
the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition. This round, when an
allied |*S.H.I.E.L.D.| character is attacking a character with the |§incinerate§Incinerate|
special condition, if the attack type is |!energy|, add 2 dice to the attack roll.

a-perfect-future.body:
When |*Nimrod, the Hunter| Dazes or KO's an enemy character during his Activation, he may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
|*Nimrod, the Hunter| moves |!movement_large|.

acute-senses.body:
During a character's activation, it may spend 1 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Enemies do not benefit from the Stealth superpower and this character ignores LOS
when attacking this activation.

advanced-r-d.body:
During its activation, a character may spend up to 5 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose a number of other allied characters equal to the |!power| spent.
Each chosen character gains 1 |!power|.

agents-of-smash.body:
If |*Hulk| and |*She-Hulk| are within |!range| 2 of the same interactive terrain
feature of Size 5 or less, they may spend 3 |!power| each to play this card.|\|
Choose |*Hulk| or |*She-Hulk| to throw the terrain feature |!range_large|.

aim-lackeys.body:
|*M.O.D.O.K.| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose another allied character. That character may perform a move
action as an additional action during its next activation this round.

all-according-to-plan.body:
During the |*Power Phase| any number of allied |*Criminal Syndicate| characters may
spend |!power| to play this card.|\|
If 10 or more |!power| was spent to play this card, take the Priority token.

all-webbed-up.body:
A |*Web Warriors| character may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Each enemy character within |!range| 3 of the character that played this card
suffers the |§slow§Slow| special condition. When an allied |*Web Warriors| character
is attacking a character suffering the Slow special condition this round, add two dice to the attack roll.

all-youve-got.body:
When a character with a Threat Level of 6 or less would gain an activated token
at the end of its activation, they may spend 4 |!power| to play this card.|\|
They do not gain an activated token, your turn does not end, and you must activate
that character again. At the end of this character's second activation, if they are
Healthy they gain a Dazed token. If they are Injured they are KO'd.

anger-management.body:
Any |*non-Hulk Avenger| character within |!range| 3 of an allied |*Hulk| may spend
up to 5 |!power| to play this card.|\|
The allied |*Hulk| suffers |!damage| equal to the Power spent and gains that much |!power|.

are-you-sure-you-want-to-remember.body:
After Deployment, an allied |*Laura Kinney| or |*James Logan Howlett| may play this card.|\|
Put 3 |<memory>Memory| tokens on this card. When an allied non-Grunt character is Dazed or KO'd by an enemy effect, this card gains 2 Memory tokens. This card can have a maximum of 3 Memory tokens.|\|
The character that played this card gains the following |!leadership| Ability and is assigned this card.

superPowers.name: It Was YOU!!! (Affiliation: Weapon X)
superPowers.body:
When an allied |*Weapon X| character is targeted by an attack, it may remove 1 |<memory>Memory| token
from this character's |*Are You Sure You Want to Remember?| Team Tactic Card. If it does, it adds 2 dice to its defense roll.
Then, after the attack is resolved, if the attack did not deal |!damage|, the allied character may
Advance Toward the attacker |!movement_small|.

asteroid-m.body:
During the |*Power Phase|, 2 |*Brotherhood of Mutants| characters may spend 2 |!power| each to play this card.|\|
Choose 1 of the characters that played this card. The chosen character drops all objective tokens it is holding. Then Place the chosen character within |!range| 1 of the other character that played this card.

astral-plane.body:
During the |*Power Phase|, |*Shadow King| may spend 1 |!power| to play this card. Choose a Secure objective token
and place an |<astral_incursion>Astral Incursion| token on it. Enemy characters suffer 1 |!damage| when they end an
Activation within |!range| 1 of the Astral Incursion, and when they interact with the objective token marked by
the Astral Incursion.|\|
During the next |*Cleanup Phase|, remove all Astral Incursion tokens.

astral-ring.body:
At the start of a |*Convocation| character’s Activation, it may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Place an allied |<projection>Projection| token within |!range| 3 of this character. While that token is on the battlefield, this character cannot Advance or
be Placed. Measure the |!range| of this character’s attacks and superpowers from that token instead of this character. This character Contests objective
tokens as if that Projection token was its base instead of Contesting objective tokens normally. Remove that Projection token from the battlefield during
the next |*Cleanup Phase|.

attilan-rising.body:
Any injured |*Inhuman| character may play this card.|\|
All allied |*Inhuman| characters gain one |!power| for each allied injured |*Inhuman| character.

aunt-mays-wheat-cakes.body:
Any number of allied |*Web Warriors| characters may spend 1 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Characters that spent |!power| remove the |§slow§Slow| special condition and remove 1 |!damage|.

avengers-assemble.body:
Any number of allied |*Avengers| characters may spend 1 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Characters that spent |!power| advance |!range_small|.

bane-of-damballah.body:
After an attack made by an allied |*Convocation| character is resolved, if the attack roll
contained one or more |!wild| or |!hit| results, it may spend 1 |!power| to play this card.|\|
The target character and enemy characters within |!range| 2 of it gain the |§root§Root| special condition.

banishment.body:
After an attack made by an allied |*Midnight Sons| character is resolved, if the attack roll
contained |!critical|, |!wild|, and |!hit| the allied character may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
The target character and enemy characters within |!range| 2 of it gain the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

basts-blessing.body:
|*T'Challa| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
|*T'Challa| makes the attack shown above.

attacks.name: Power of the Mother God
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the target character.

|!wild| |!wild| |*Hunter's Joy|: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 2 of the target character that has not been targeted by |*Power of the Mother God| this turn. This character makes a |*Power of the Mother God| attack targeting the chosen character.

bats-the-ghost-hound.body:
When an allied |*Midnight Sons| character is modifying its attack or defense dice, it may
spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Change 1 of the allied character's attack or defense dice to any result. This effect may
change |!failure| results.

battle-bound.body:
When |*Archangel| begins a move action within |!range| 3 of an allied |*Psylocke| during his Activation, he may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
When |*Archangel| ends this move, place |*Psylocke| within |!range| 1 of him. |*Psylocke| may immediately perform one of her attacks that has a listed |!power| cost of 0.

battle-lust.body:
At the end of a move action made during an allied character's activation, the moving
character may spend |!power| equal to its size to play this card.|\|
The next attack made by the moving character this activation adds dice to the attack equal
to its size. If the attack deals damage, after the attack is resolved, push the target
character away |!range_small|.

battle-plan.body:
During |*Steve Rogers|' Activation he may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
|*Steve Rogers| and each allied character within |!range| 3 of him may choose one of the following effects:|\|
|~Remove 1 special condition.|
|~Remove 1 &!damage&.|
|~Place within &!range& 1 of their current position.|

battlefield-medicine.body:
During a |*S.H.I.E.L.D.| character's Activation, it may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Remove up to 3 |!damage| and 1 special condition from this character or an allied
character within |!range| 3 of this character.|\|
This card may not be included in a Roster or a Squad with the |*Medpack| Team Tactic Card.

bear-hug.body:
When an enemy character declares a move action while within |!range| 1 of an
allied |*Ursa Major|, |*Ursa Major| may play this card.|\|
The enemy character may spend 3 |!power|. If they do not, they can only use the |!range_small| movement
tool when resolving this move action.

bird-of-prey.body:
When |*Sam Wilson| targets an enemy character that has the Flight |!innate| superpower with
an attack, he may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
|*Sam Wilson| adds 3 dice to the attack roll against that character and may reroll any number
of attack dice during this attack. If this attack deals damage, the enemy character loses the
Flight |!innate| superpower until the end of the round.

bitter-rivals.body:
Any character may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose an enemy character. Until the end of the round, other enemy characters
within |!range| 3 of the chosen character roll 1 less die on attack and defense rolls.

black-onslaught.body:
If |*Black Swan| is within |!range| 2 of an allied |*Black Dwarf| when she uses the
Charge |!active| superpower, they may each spend 1 |!power| to play this card.|\|
After the Charge movement action is resolved but before making the attack action, you
may place |*Black Dwarf| within |!range| 1 of |*Black Swan|.

blood-red-and-personal.body:
During the Power Phase, an allied |*Punisher| may spend 4 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Each time an enemy character is KO'd this round, this character's controlling player gains 1 VP.

blood-to-spare.body:
When a |*Black Order| character would be Dazed by an enemy effect, it may
spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
The character immediately performs an attack before gaining the Dazed token. If this attack
results in the character removing damage, it is not Dazed.

book-of-cagliostro.body:
Choose a |*Convocation| character. The chosen character and two other characters
within |!range| 3 of it may spend 2 |!power| each to play this card.|\|
Remove the Activated token from the chosen character.|\|
During the |*Cleanup Phase|, you may discard two Team Tactic cards. If you do, return this card to
your available Team Tactic cards. This card may be played again this game.

bounty-hunters.body:
After deployment is complete, an allied |*Elektra| or allied |*Taskmaster| may play this card.|\|
Mark the enemy character with the highest Threat Value with a |<bounty>Bounty| token. If the marked character
is Dazed or KO'd by the character that played this card during its activation, the character
that played this card immediately makes one action after the effect is resolved, and the
Bounty token is removed from the marked character.|\|
If there is a tie for the highest Threat Value, choose one of the tied characters to receive the Bounty token.

brace-for-impact.body:
If one or more allied characters would suffer a collision, they may each spend
1 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Characters that spent |!power| do not suffer |!damage| from this collision.

brand-new-day.body:
When an enemy character would be Dazed or KO'd while within |!range| 3 of an allied |*Mephisto, Lord of Temptation|, he may play this card. The enemy character's controlling player chooses one of the following effects:|\|
|~The enemy character is not Dazed or KO'd and removes 1 &!damage&, all special conditions, and up to one Activated token from itself.&\&Additionally, &*Mephisto, Lord of Temptation& gains 2 &<devils_deal>Devil's Deal& tokens and removes an Activated token from any allied character.|
|~&*Mephisto, Lord of Temptation& removes all &!damage& and special conditions from himself and gains 3 &!power&.|

brief-reprieve.body:
|*Ultimate Spider-Man| and any number of other allied characters may spend 1 |!power| each to play this card.|\|
Each character that played this card may remove 1 special condition or 1 |!damage|. Then, each character that played this card that has an Activated token may gain 1 |!power|.

brothers-in-arms.body:
|*Thor Odinson| and |*Beta Ray Bill| may spend 1 |!power| each to play this card.|\|
While within |!range| 2 of each other this Round, the characters that played this card gain the
superpower shown below.

superPowers.name: The Worthy
superPowers.body:
This character may not be Advanced, Thrown or Placed by enemy effects. Additionally, this character adds 3 dice
to all |!energy| attacks it makes.

building-the-mother-mold.body:
During the |*Cleanup Phase| of Round 6, after scoring VPs from Crisis Cards, any number of allied |*Sentinels| characters may spend any amount of |!power| to play this card.|\|
If 11 or more |!power| was spent to play this card, gain 6 VPs.

call-for-backup.body:
During his Activation, |*Nova| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose one of the following:|\|
|~&*Move Along, Citizen!&: Choose a Secure objective token within &!range& 2 of this character. Push each enemy character Contesting that objective &!movement_small&.|
|~&*Stop, in the Name of the Law!&: Each enemy character that is holding an Extract objective token gains the Slow special condition.|

call-the-pack.body:
When an allied |*Weapon X| character removes |!damage| from itself, it may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
The character that played this card Advances |!range_small|. Then all allied characters
within |!range| 3 of it may Advance |!range_small| toward the character that played this card.

can-i-borrow-that.body:
After an attack made by an allied |*Quicksilver| that damaged an enemy character holding an
Asset token is resolved, |*Quicksilver| may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Move one Asset token from the target character to |*Quicksilver|. He picks up and is now holding
that token. This card does not allow a character to hold more tokens than the crisis specifies.

carbonadium-synthesizer.body:
|*Omega Red| may play this card.|\|
Remove all special conditions from this character. It removes 1 |!damage| and gains 1 |!power| for each special condition removed in this way.

carnage-rules.body:
|*Carnage| may spend 4 |!power| during his activation to play this card.|\|
Choose an enemy character within |!range| 4 of |*Carnage|. Advance the chosen
character |!range_small| toward |*Carnage|. After the advance, |*Carnage| may make a |*Symbiote Tendrils| attack
targeting the chosen character.

cat-and-mouse.body:
After all characters have been deployed, an |*X-Force| character may play this card.|\|
Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This character cannot make
more than one move action during its next activation.

caught-in-a-ham.body:
During |*Spider-Ham|'s Activation, he may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
For each enemy character within |!range| 3 of |*Spider-Ham| when this card is played, roll 1 die and resolve the corresponding effect below.
Completely resolve each effect in the order of your choosing before moving on to the next.|\|
|*Porker Popper|: If the result is a |!wild|, the enemy character gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.|\|
|*...Is that a Cartoon Pig?|: If the result is a |!critical|, the enemy character gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.|\|
|*Slopped Up|: If the result is a |!block|, the enemy character gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition.|\|
|*Corny Joke|: If the result is a |!hit|, the enemy character loses 1 |!power|.|\|
|*Oh No!|: If the result is a |!failure|, the opposing player Places |*Spider-Ham| within |!range| 2 of his current position.

cerebro.body:
During its Activation, an |*Uncanny X-Men|
character with at least one |!mystic| attack and at least
5 |!mystic| Defense may play this card.|\|
For the rest of this Round, the character that
played this card increases the Range of its |!mystic|
attacks by 1 (to a maximum of 5), adds 1 die to its
|!mystic| attacks, and adds 1 die to its |!mystic| defense rolls.|\|
Additionally, this character's attacks do not
require LOS and ignore the |*Stealth| |!innate|
superpower for the rest of this Round.

charming-thief.body:
During the Power Phase, |*Gambit| may play this card.|\|
This round, when an enemy character within |!range| 4 of |*Gambit| uses
an |!active| or |!reactive| superpower, |*Gambit| gains 1 |!power| after the effect is resolved.

chi-mastery.body:
When |*Shang-Chi| makes an attack, during the |*Modify Dice| step of the attack, he may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
|*Shang-Chi| may change 2 results in either the attack or defense roll to any other result.

children-of-the-atom.body:
An |*Uncanny X-Men| character may play this card.|\|
Remove all special conditions from this character. It gains 1 |!power| for each special
condition removed in this way.

chimichangas.body:
|*Deadpool| may spend 1 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Add a |<chimichanga>Chimichanga| objective token (Asset) to the game. |*Deadpool| is holding this
token. At the end of a character's activation, if it is holding a Chimichanga token it
gains 1 |!power| and may remove 1 |!damage| or one special condition.|\|
Any character may use the following Interact ability:|\|
|*Interact (Chimichanga)|: Pick up the Chimichanga token.

chronal-manipulation.body:
When this card is revealed during |*Deployment|, |*Nathaniel Richards| may play it.|\|
Choose a Round on the Mission Tracker without an allied |<timestream>Timestream| token and put an allied Timestream token on it. Return this card to your available Team Tactic Cards during the first |*Cleanup Phase|. It may be played again this Game.
chronal-manipulation.secondaryBody:
During the |*Power Phase|, |*Nathaniel Richards| may spend 4 |!power| to play this card.|\|
You may remove an allied Timestream token from the current Round. If you do, choose an allied character and resolve 2 of the effects below.|\|
Otherwise, choose an allied character and resolve 1 of the effects below.
|~The chosen character may remove up to 2 &!damage& or special conditions from itself in any combination.|
|~The chosen character may Place itself within &!range& 2 of its current position.|
|~The chosen character gains 2 &!power&.|

An allied |*Agent Venom| and allied |*Peter Parker| may each spend 1 |!power| to play this card during the |*Power Phase|.|\|
|*Agent Venom| gains the |*Spider-Sense| |!innate| superpower until the end of the round.|\|
clean-up.intermediaryBody: |*Peter Parker| gains the |*Symbiotic Instincts| |!innate| superpower until the end of the round.

superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack or making a dodge roll, it may reroll up to 2 of its defense or dodge dice.

superPowers.name: Symbiotic Instincts
superPowers.body: While this character is attacking, the defending character cannot modify its defense dice.

climbing-gear.body:
Any character may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
This character gains Wall Crawler until the end of the round. This character
immediately advances |!range_small|.

An allied |*Web Warriors| character may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose an enemy character with the same name or Alter-Ego as the character that played this card. The character that played this card gains the superpower shown below.

superPowers.name: Imposter Syndrome
superPowers.body: When attacking the chosen character, the character that played this card can modify or reroll |!failure| results and may reroll any number of dice.

cloning-banks.body:
During any |*Cleanup Phase|, an allied |*Mister Sinister| may play this card.|\|
When this card is played, set it near the battlefield instead of discarding it. During each |*Cleanup Phase|, including the one in which this card is played, |*Mister Sinister| may move any number of |<genetic_sample>Genetic Sample| tokens from himself to this card.|\|
If this card has been played, during any |*Power Phase|, you may remove any number of Genetic Sample tokens from this card and discard it.
If you do, Place an unused character from your roster with a Threat Value equal to half the number of Genetic Samples removed (rounding down) or lower into play within |!range| 1 of an allied |*Mister Sinister|. The unused character gains 3 |!power| and is now part of your squad.

comrades-keeper.body:
When an enemy character targets an allied character within |!range| 3 of an allied |*Red Guardian| with
an attack, |*Red Guardian| may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Place |*Red Guardian| within |!range| 2 of the allied character. |*Red Guardian| becomes the target
of the attack regardless of range and LOS. If |*Red Guardian| suffers |!damage| from the attack, and
is not Dazed, after the attack is resolved, throw the attacking character away
from |*Red Guardian| |!range_small|.

corporate-espionage.body:
When an allied character Dazes or KO's an enemy character, after the effect is resolved, that allied character may pay 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
An allied |*Iron Monger| gains the |*Stolen Stark Tech| |!reactive| superpower.

superPowers.body: When this character is defending, after the attack is resolved, this character may use this superpower. If the attacker is |!size| 3 or less, Push it Away from this character |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

cosmic-awareness.body:
After |*Deployment|, |*Adam Warlock| may play this card.|\|
When this card is played, set it near the battlefield instead of discarding it. Place 1 |!block| token on this card. |*Adam Warlock| gains the following |!leadership| ability. It is your active |!leadership|.

superPowers.name: Cosmic Awareness (Affiliation: Guardians of the Galaxy)
superPowers.body:
When an allied character attacks, defends, or dodges, during the |*Modify Dice| step, it may use this |!leadership| ability. If it does, choose 1 of that character's dice and add a token matching that die's result to the set-aside |*Cosmic Awareness| card. Then remove a different token on that card and change the chosen die's result to match that token. This |!leadership| ability can modify |!failure| results and can be used only once per Turn.|\|
Additionally, this character may use the |!active| or |!reactive| superpowers of Infinity Gems without paying the |!power| Cost.

cosmic-invigoration.body:
If |*Red Skull| is within |!range| 2 of another allied character with an Activated token, they may
spend 2 |!power| each to play this card.|\|
Remove the Activated token from the allied character and roll three dice. For each |!critical|,
|!wild|, and |!hit| rolled, that character suffers 1 |!damage|.

cosmic-obliteration.body:
|*Johann Schmidt| may spend any amount of |!power| to play this card.|\|
Remove all special conditions from |*Johann Schmidt|. Then choose one non-Dazed enemy character within |!range| 3 of |*Johann Schmidt| for each
|!power| spent to play this card. Each chosen character gains one of the following special conditions: |§hex§Hex|, |§root§Root|, or |§incinerate§Incinerate|.

During the |*Power Phase|, an allied |*Defenders| character may spend 4 |!power| to play this card.|\|
This Round, after an attack targeting this character is resolved, another allied character may make an attack targeting the attacking enemy character.

covering-fire.body:
During the |*Power Phase|, an allied |*Elsa Bloodstone| may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
While this character is not Dazed, until the end of the Round, once per Turn, after the first time each Turn an attack targeting this character or another allied character is resolved, if the attacker is within |!range| 4 of this character, this character may roll 5 dice. If it does, it deals 1 |!damage| to the attacking character for each |!critical| and |!wild| in the result.

crew-of-the-milano.body:
Any number of allied |*Guardians of the Galaxy| characters may spend 1 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Each character that spent |!power| removes all special conditions and cannot suffer special conditions
this round.

When an allied |*Psylocke| flips her Stat Card to its Injured side, she may spend 3 |!power| to play this card. |*Psylocke|
gains the superpower shown below.

superPowers.name: Mark of the Crimson Dawn
superPowers.body:
At the beginning of this character's Activation and after each of its actions, this character may Place itself within |!range| 1.|\|
Additionally, this character gains |*Healing Factor [1]|.

During a |*Criminal Syndicate| character's activation, it may spend 1 |!power| to play this card.|\|
The next attack made by this character this turn adds 3 dice to its attack roll. If the attack roll
contains one or more |!failure| results, the attacking character gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special
condition at the end of its activation.

If an allied character deals |!damage| to an enemy character with an attack during its Activation, after
the attack is resolved, the attacking character may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|

This attack can only have dice added to the attack from |!critical| results, and this character cannot
modify its attack dice during this attack.

When this character rolls defense dice, if the chosen character is not attacking, it removes 2 dice from its defense roll.

superPowers.name: Dynamic Response

If that allied character is within |!range| 3, this character may make an attack with a |!power| cost of 0 against the attacker. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

During the Power Phase, an allied |*Darkstar| may spend 1 |!power| to play this card.|\|
This round, other characters within |!range| 3 of |*Darkstar| roll one fewer defense dice when defending against |!energy| attacks.

dark-empowerment.body:
During an allied character's Activation, it may suffer 1 |!damage| to play this card.|\|
Choose another allied character within |!range| 3 of the Active character. Effects of the next
attack made this Turn by the Active character cannot cause it to gain |!power|. After the attack is resolved, the chosen
character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt by the attack.

dark-past.body:
During the Power Phase, if your squad is not using the |*Uncanny X-Men| affiliation, |*Gambit| may
play this card.|\|
Each allied character within |!range| 3 of |*Gambit| gains the Stealth |!innate| superpower |<dark_past>until the end of the round|.

superPowers.name: Stealth
superPowers.body: Characters must be within |!range| 3 of this character to target it with attacks.

dark-reign.body:
Any |*Cabal| character may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose an enemy character. Allied |*Cabal| characters may reroll any number of attack dice
when attacking the chosen character this round.

dark-restoration.body:
During the |*Cleanup Phase|, |*Dormammu| may spend 6 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Place an allied character of Threat Value 3 or less that has been KO'd this game
within |!range| 2 of |*Dormammu|. The character is healthy and has no damage,
special conditions or effects.

data-backup.body:
When an allied |*Vision| would be KO'd, |*Iron Lad| may spend 5 |!power| to play this card.|\|
|*Vision| is not KO'd. Instead, he removes all |!damage| and special conditions from himself and drops all objective tokens he is holding.

daughters-of-thanos.body:
When either an allied |*Gamora| or an allied |*Nebula| makes an attack action, after the
attack is resolved, both characters may spend 1 |!power| each to play this card.|\|
The character (|*Gamora| or |*Nebula|) that did not make the initial attack may make an attack
targeting the same target character.

deadly-duo.body:
During |*Rocket Raccoon|'s activation, if he is within |!range| 2 of an allied |*Groot|,
both characters may spend 2 |!power| each to play this card.|\|
|*Rocket Raccoon| may immediately perform up to three Plasma Rifle attacks. Each attack must
target a different enemy character.

deal-with-the-devil.body:
If |*Ghost Rider| is KO'd, he may spend 4 |!power| to play this card before he is removed from
the battlefield.|\|
Choose another allied character. |*Ghost Rider| removes all special conditions, removes all |!damage| and
Activated tokens, drops all objective tokens, and is then placed within |!range| 1 of the chosen character.
If the chosen character was Healthy, flip |*Ghost Rider|'s card to the Healthy Side. Enemy characters
within |!range| 2 of |*Ghost Rider| then suffer the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition. The
chosen character is KO'd.

death-from-above.body:
|*Archangel| may spend 2 |!power| to play this card at the start of his Activation if he is overlapping a terrain feature.|\|
This Turn, when |*Archangel| attacks a character that is not overlapping a terrain feature or is overlapping a terrain feature of a lesser Size than the terrain feature |*Archangel| was overlapping when this card was played, add 2 dice to the attack roll.

deception.body:
|*Mystique| may play this card.|\|
Choose an enemy character within |!range| 4 of this character. If there are no other non-Dazed
enemy characters within |!range| 2 of the chosen character, you may advance the chosen character
its Speed toward this character.

deeds-worth-of-song.body:
During the |*Power Phase|, an allied |*Asgard| character may play this card. When this card is played, set it near the battlefield instead of discarding it.|\|
The first time each of the following conditions is met, put 1 |<worthy_deeds>Worthy Deeds| token on this card.|\|
|*Slay the Monster|: An allied character KO‘s an enemy character that has a |!threat| of 5 or more.|\|
|*Drive Out the Invaders|: 2 or more enemy characters are Dazed or KO'd by collisions during an allied character's Activation.|\|
|*Protect the Small|: An allied character Dazes or KO‘s 2 or more enemy characters durings its Activation and ends that Activation within |!range| 2 of another allied character that has a |!threat| of 2 or less.|\|
|*Ragnarok|: An allied character is Dazed or KO‘d, and 2 or more other allied characters have been Dazed of KO‘d this Round.|\|
If this card has been played, during any |*Cleanup Phase|, you may remove 2 Worthy Deeds tokens from this card and discard it. If you do, score 2 VPs.

defensive-prototype.body:
Two |*S.H.I.E.L.D.| characters may both spend 1 |!power| to play this card.|\|
While these characters are within |!range| 3 of each other this Round, they cannot be Pushed, Thrown, or
Placed by enemy effects, and Advancing enemy characters cannot Place a Movement Tool that would
overlap either allied character or a straight line drawn between them, unless the enemy characters
are climbing. Characters cannot draw LOS through these characters or through a straight line drawn
between them this Round.

devils-reckoning.body:
When this card is included in your Squad, if your Squad is Unaffiliated and includes |*Mephisto, Lord of Temptation|, he may play this card.|\|
Your Squad is now using the |*Legion of the Lost| affiliation regardless of other affiliated characters. |*Mephisto, Lord of Temptation| gains the following Leadership ability. It is your active Leadership.

superPowers.name: Damnation (Affiliation: Legion of the Lost)
superPowers.body:
During the |*Cleanup Phase|, your opponent chooses 1 non-Dazed character they control without the Incinerate special condition or the |*Immunity [Incinerate]| |!innate| superpower.
The chosen character gains 1 |!power| and the Incinerate special condition.|\|
Additionally, during the |*Cleanup Phase|, choose 2 characters you control. The chosen characters gain 1 |!power|.

difficult-to-please.body:
If an allied |*Scarlet Witch| has Dazed or KO'd an enemy character this round AND an
allied |*Quicksilver| has interacted with or picked up an objective token this round, |*Magneto| may
play this card.|\|
You may remove an Activated token from |*Magneto|.

dig-in.body:
During the |*Power Phase|, an allied |*Brock Rumlow| may play this card.|\|
This Round, |*Brock Rumlow| cannot be moved by enemy or allied effects.|\|
Additionaly, for the rest of this Round, while defending, |*Brock Rumlow| may reroll any number of his dice.

dimensional-quagmire.body:
During the |*Power Phase|, an allied |*Man-Thing| may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
While this character is not Dazed, until the end of the Round, once per Turn, the first time each Turn an enemy character begins a movement within |!range| 3 of |*Man-Thing|
and ends that movement not within |!range| 3 of him, roll a die. If the result is a |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!hit|, Place the enemy character within |!range| 3 of |*Man-Thing|.

directive-one.body:
During the Power Phase, allied |*Sentinels| characters may each spend 1 |!power|. If at least
2 |!power| was spent this way, you may play this card.|\|
Until the end of this round, enemy characters do not benefit from the Stealth superpower and
cannot reroll or modify defense dice. Additionally, allied characters do not require LOS to target
enemy characters with attacks until the end of this round.

dirty-work.body:
An allied |*X-Force| character may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Mark the enemy character with the highest Threat Value with a |<target>Target| token. If the marked
character is Dazed or KO'd this round by an allied |*X-Force| character, all allied |*X-Force|
characters gain 2 |!power|.|\|
If there is a tie for the highest Threat Value, choose one of the tied characters to receive the Target token.

disarm.body:
When two allied characters are within |!range| 3 of the same enemy character, the allied
characters may spend 1 |!power| each to play this card.|\|
The enemy character rolls two fewer dice on all attacks this round, to a minimum of 1.

do-you-know-who-i-am.body:
|*Juggernaut| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of Size 4 or less and
within |!range| 2 of |*Juggernaut|, and throw it |!range_large|.

doomed-prophecy.body:
At the start of the activation phase, an allied |*Asgard| character may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
This character cannot roll defense dice against |!physical| attacks for the rest of the game. Additionally,
this character adds dice to its |!physical| attacks equal to its |!physical| defense until the next
Cleanup Phase.

dossier.body:
During the first |*Power Phase|, an allied |*Logan, The Wolverine|, |*Sabretooth, Apex Predator|,
or |*X-23| character may play this card.|\|
Your opponent chooses one of their characters. It is now holding the |<dossier>Dossier| (Asset) objective
token. If an allied |*Weapon X| character is holding this token, its movement speed
becomes |!range_large| and it adds 2 dice to its attack rolls. Any character may use the following
Interact ability:|\|
|*Interact (Dossier)|: Pick up this token.|\|
Additionally, the character that played this card gains the superpower shown below.

superPowers.name: GIVE ME THAT!!!
superPowers.body:
When attacking the character holding the Dossier token, this character may modify or
reroll |!failure| results and may reroll any number of attack dice. At the start of this
character's activation, if there is an enemy character holding the Dossier token within |!range| 2
of this character, this character's first action must be an attack action targeting that character, if able.

double-agent.body:
At the start of the |*Activation Phase|, an allied |*Spider-Woman| may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose an enemy character. The next time the chosen character gains an Activated token, remove an Activated token
from |*Spider-Woman|.

douglas-family.body:
During |*Drax| or |*Moondragon|'s Activation, 1 or both of those character may spend any number of |!power| to play this card.|\|
If 4 or more |!power| was spent to play this card, choose an enemy character.|\|
If |*Drax| is on the battlefield, put a |<vengeance>Vengeance| token on or move an existing Vengeance token to the chosen enemy character. Then |*Drax| may Advance |!movement_medium| Toward the chosen character.|\|
Additionally, if |*Moondragon| is on the battlefield, she may make a |*Psionic Barrage| attack targeting the chosen character. When |*Moondragon| attacks the chosen character this Turn, she adds |!failure| results in the chosen character's defense roll to her total successes.

drop-off.body:
When an allied character with |*Flight| begins a move action within |!range| 2 of another allied
character of an equal or smaller size during its activation, they may spend 1 |!power| each
to play this card before moving the miniature.|\|
When the active character ends this move, place the allied character within |!range| 1 of it.
The placed character may immediately perform one of its attacks that has a listed |!power| cost of 0.

efficient-machines.body:
During the Power Phase, an allied |*Cassandra Nova| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Until the end of this round, allied |*Sentinels| characters within |!range| 3 of |*Cassandra Nova|
treat |!block| results as |!wild| results.

elemental-infusion.body:
|*Crystal| may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Until this character is Dazed or until the end of the round, when an enemy character that
is within |!range| 3 of |*Crystal| suffers damage from an allied effect, after the effect is
resolved that character gains one of the following special
conditions: |§incinerate§Incinerate|, |§stun§Stun|, or |§slow§Slow|.

embrace-the-inferno.body:
During the |*Power Phase|, an allied |*Mephisto, Lord of Temptation| may spend 4 |!power| to play this card.|\|
All other characters within |!range| 3 of |*Mephisto, Lord of Temptation| gain the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.|\|
This Round, when an allied character with the Incinerate special condition is attacking, it may reroll all of its attack dice. If it does and the attack deals |!damage|, it removes the Incinerate special condition after the attack is resolved.

endless-legions.body:
During the Power Phase, |*Red Skull, Master of Hydra| may play this card.|\|
Each time an allied |*Hydra Troopers| would be KO'd this round, remove all damage from
them. They are not KO'd. Then an opposing player pushes them |!range_small| instead.

escort-to-safety.body:
When an enemy character targets an allied character with an attack, another allied character
within |!range| 3 of the targeted character may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Push the targeted allied character toward the other allied character |!range_small|. If at the
end of the Push the targeted character is outside of the attack's Range or the attacker's LOS, the
attack ends. If it is the attacker's activation, and the attack did not target multiple characters,
they may make another action.

execute.body:
When |*Corvus Glaive| targets an enemy character with an attack that is within |!range| 1 of
an allied |*Proxima Midnight|, or when |*Proxima Midnight| targets an enemy character with an
attack that is within |!range| 1 of an allied |*Corvus Glaive|, both characters may spend 2 |!power| to
play this card.|\|
The enemy character rolls no defense dice during this attack.

extinction-event.body:
During |*Omega Sentinel|'s Activation, she may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
|*Omega Sentinel| makes the |*Extinction Beam| attack shown above.

attacks.name: Extinction Beam
steps: |!critical| |!wild| |!hit| |*Strafe|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Extinction Beam| attack without paying the |!power| cost. This additional attack must target a character within |!range| 2 of the original defender that has not been targeted by |*Extinction Beam| this Round.

extreme-conditioning.body:
When a character begins a move action during its activation, it may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
If the active character advances, it may use the |!range_large| movement tool during this movement.

extreme-measures.body:
At the start of his Activation, an allied |*Ronin| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
This Activation, |*Ronin|'s |*Shadow Strike| attack gains the following special rule:|\|
|!wild| |*Flurry|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make another |*Shadow Strike| attack. The additional attack does not have the |*Flurry| special rule.|\|
This Activation, |*Ronin|'s |*The Hawk's Blades| attack gains the following special rule:|\|
|!hit| |*Rapid Fire|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make another |*The Hawk's Blades| attack. The additional attack must target the original target character and does not have the |*Rapid Fire| special rule.

eye-in-the-sky.body:
When an allied character is targeted by an attack, |*Nick Fury| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
The targeted character Advances |!range_small|. If the character is
outside of the attack's |!range| or the attacker's LOS at the end of the Advance, the attack ends. If it is the attacker's Activation
and the attack did not target multiple characters, the attacker may make another action.|\|
If your Squad is using the |*S.H.I.E.L.D.| affiliation, return this card to your available Team Tactic
Cards during the |*Cleanup Phase|. This card may be played again this Game.

eyes-on-the-prize.body:
At the start of any allied character's activation, it may spend 1 |!power| to play this card.|\|
During this activation, this character can interact with objectives at |!range| 2 instead of the
normal |!range| 1.

face-me.body:
During an allied character's activation, it may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose an enemy character within |!range| 4 of this character. Advance the enemy character its Speed towards
this character. After the advance, the chosen character's controller may make one attack with the
chosen character.

faithful-companion.body:
When an allied |*Shadowcat| or |*Magik| is dealt |!damage| by an enemy attack or superpower, after the effect is resolved, she
may play this card.|\|
The character that played this card immediately makes the attack shown above targeting the enemy character that dealt her |!damage|.

steps: This attack ignores Range and LOS.
|!wild| |*Incinerate|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

fall-back.body:
When an allied character is attacked, before |!damage| is dealt it may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
This character may advance |!range_small| away from the attacking character.

fallen.body:
When an allied |*Angel| would flip his Stat Card to the Injured side, he may play this card.|\|
If |*Archangel| is not in your Squad, Push all enemy characters within |!range| 2 of |*Angel| Away |!range_small|.
Pushed characters gain the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition. Then Place |*Archangel| within |!range| 1 of |*Angel|. Flip his Stat Card to the Injured side.
He is now part of your Squad and gains |!power| equal to the amount of |!power| |*Angel| has. Then remove |*Angel| from the game.

fan-club.body:
When an allied |*Captain Marvel (Carol Danvers)| uses the |*Danvers Special| |!active| superpower,
the |*Binary Form| |!active| superpower, or the |*Rocket Punch| attack, after the effect or attack
is resolved, an allied |*Ms. Marvel (Kamala Khan)| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
If |*Captain Marvel| used the |*Danvers Special| superpower, |*Ms. Marvel| may throw an interactive terrain
feature or enemy character of Size 3 or less and within |!range| 2. It is thrown |!range_small|.|\|
If |*Captain Marvel| used the |*Binary Form| superpower, |*Ms. Marvel (Normal)| may transform into
|*Ms. Marvel (Embiggened)|. After transforming, push all enemy characters within |!range| 2 of
|*Ms. Marvel| away |!range_small| in the order of your choosing.|\|
If |*Captain Marvel| used the |*Rocket Punch| attack, |*Ms. Marvel| may advance |!range_medium| toward
the target character.

fastball-special.body:
If |*Colossus| is within |!range| 2 of an allied |*Wolverine|, both characters may spend 1 |!power| to
play this card.|\|
Throw the allied |*Wolverine| |!range_medium|. |*Wolverine| does not suffer collision damage during this
throw. Enemy characters that he collides with roll 2 fewer dodge dice and suffer the
|§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

fault-line.body:
During the |*Power Phase|, an allied |*Avalanche| and an allied |*Pyro| may spend 1 |!power| each to play this card.|\|
This Round, |*Avalanche| and |*Pyro| increase the |!range| of their |*Seismokinesis| and |*Flame Jet| attacks to |!range| B5.

fearful-symmetry.body:
When |*Kraven the Hunter| KO's an enemy |*Peter Parker|, if there is no |*Peter Parker| in your squad,
|*Kraven the Hunter| may play this card.|\|
|*Kraven the Hunter| transforms into |*Spider-Man (Peter Parker)|. Replace |*Kraven the Hunter|'s stat
card with |*Spider-Man's (Peter Parker's)| stat card with its Healthy side up. Move all damage
tokens, power, special conditions, objective tokens, and effects from |*Kraven the Hunter|
to |*Spider-Man (Peter Parker)|. |*Spider-Man (Peter Parker)| is now part of your squad.

Remove a Dazed token and 1 |!damage| from the allied character.

Each allied |*Uncanny X-Men| character does not have to spend |!power| the first time they interact
with an objective token this round.

normally select your |!leadership| ability, an allied |*Corvus Glaive| may play this card.|\|

Choose 1 non-|*S.H.I.E.L.D.|-affiliated character in your Squad. When the chosen character is deployed, it
gains a |<gadget>Gadget| token and is now a |*S.H.I.E.L.D.|-affiliated character.|\|
The character with the Gadget token may use any of the following special rules:|\|
|~When this character is defending, it may discard the Gadget token to reroll 1 of its defense dice.||\|
|~During this character's Activation, it may discard the Gadget token to remove 1 special condition from itself.||\|
|~During this character's Activation, it may discard the Gadget token to move 1 objective token it is holding from itself to an allied character within &!range& 1 of itself or from an allied character within &!range& 1 of this character to this character. This card does not allow a character to hold more tokens than the Crisis specifies.|

the-invaders.body:
After Deployment, an allied |*Namor, the Sub-Mariner| or |*Steve Rogers, Captain America| may play this card.|\|
The character that played this card gains the following Leadership ability:

superPowers.name: The Invaders (Affiliation: S.H.I.E.L.D.)
superPowers.body: Allied characters may reroll 1 defense die. Additionally, they can modify and reroll |!failure| results while they are within |!range| 2 of another allied character.

the-magus.body:
When an allied |*Adam Warlock| that has the |*Infinity Gem: Bonded Soul| and does not have a |!leadership| ability would be Dazed, he must play this card.|\|
Discard that |*Adam Warlock|'s |*Infinity Gem: Bonded Soul|.|\|
That |*Adam Warlock| gains the |*Occult Magicks| |!innate| superpower.

superPowers.name: Occult Magicks
superPowers.body:
When this character makes an attack action, after that action is resolved, choose up to 1 enemy character not targeted by that attack. The chosen character loses 1 |!power| and this character may gain 1 |!power| or remove up to 1 |!damage| or special condition from itself.|\|
Additionally, when an enemy character loses 1 or more |!power|, if this character caused that effect, that enemy character suffers 1 |!damage|. That enemy character does not gain |!power| for |!damage| suffered in this way.

the-man-of-marvels.body:
During |*Blue Marvel|'s Activation, he may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
|*Blue Marvel| and each other allied character within |!range| 3 may choose 1 of the following effects:
|~&*Anti-Matter Healing&: That character removes up to 2 &!damage& from itself.|
|~&*Energy Creation&: That character gains 1 &!power&.|
|~&*Particle Manipulation&: Place that character within &!range& 1 of its current position.|

the-pawns-go-first.body:
During the |*Cleanup Phase|, any number of allied |*Brotherhood of Mutants| characters with a Threat Value of 3 or less may pay 1 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Each character that played this card may choose an allied |*Brotherhood of Mutants| character with a Threat Value of 5 or greater within |!range| 3 and choose 1 of the following options below. Resolve each option completely before choosing the next.|\|
|~Advance &!movement_small& Toward the chosen character.|
|~Remove 1 &!damage& and 1 special condition from the chosen character.|
|~The chosen character gains 1 &!power&.|

the-shieldmobile.body:
An allied |*S.H.I.E.L.D.| character may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
This character gains the |*Flight| |!innate| superpower this Round. It immediately Advances |!range_large|.

the-ultimates.body:
During a |*Mighty Avengers| character's Activation, any number of allied |*Mighty Avengers| characters may spend 1 or more |!power| to play this card.|\|
The Activating character makes the |*Empowered Assault| attack shown above.

attacks.name: Empowered Assault
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical| or |!energy|.
Add dice to this attack roll equal to the amount of |!power| spent to play this card.
|!wild| |*Energy Overload|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender and each other enemy character within |!range| 2 of it gain the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

the-whims-of-chaos.body:
|*Scarlet Witch| may spend any number of |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose one non-Dazed character within |!range| 3 of Scarlet Witch for each |!power| spent to play this card. Each chosen allied
character may remove 1 |!damage| or one special condition. Each chosen enemy character gains one of the following special
conditions: |§hex§Hex|, |§root§Root|, or |§incinerate§Incinerate|.

the-white-hot-room.body:
When an allied |*Phoenix Unleashed| would be KO'd, she may play this card.|\|
When this card is played, set it near the battlefield instead of discarding it. Put 2 |!power| on this card.|\|
If this card has been played, during the |*Power Phase|, remove 1 |!power| from this card. When the last |!power| on this card is removed, choose an allied character and Place |*Phoenix| within |!range| 2 of it. |*Phoenix| is now part of your Squad. Then, discard this card.

there-will-be-carnage.body:
|*Carnage| may spend any number of |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose one enemy character within |!range| 3 of |*Carnage| for each |!power| spent. The chosen characters gain the |§root§Root| special condition.

they-say-keep-your-enemies-close.body:
|*Squirrel Girl| or |*Gwenpool| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
During the next attack made by the character that played this card, if that attack targets an enemy character within |!range| 1,
the target character rolls no defense dice during the attack.|\|
During the next attack made by the character that played this card, if that attack targets an enemy character that is not
within |!range| 1, after the attack is resolved, Place the target character within |!range| 1 of the character that
played this card.

this-is-a-robbery.body:
During |*Rhino|'s Activation, he may spend 4 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose an enemy character within |!range| 1 that is holding an Objective token. The chosen character drops any
Objective tokens it is holding. |*Rhino| then Throws the chosen character |!range_medium|.

this-is-our-day.body:
During the |*Power Phase|, if you have fewer VPs than your opponent, an allied |*Otto Octavius| may play this card.|\|
This Round, each time an allied character would drop an objective token, you may place it instead of your opponent.
You may place it within |!range| 3 instead of the normal |!range| 2.|\|
Additionally, each time an allied non-Grunt character would be Dazed or KO'd this Round, each enemy character within |!range| 2
of it suffers 1 |!damage|.

thralls-of-dracula.body:
When this card is included in your Squad, if your Squad is Unaffiliated and includes |*Dracula|, you may play this card.|\|
Your Squad is now using the |*Thralls of Dracula| Affiliation regardless of other affiliated characters. |*Dracula| gains the following Leadership ability. It is your active Leadership.

superPowers.name: Bloodlust (Affiliation: Thralls of Dracula)
superPowers.body:
Once per Turn, during an allied character's Activation, it may pay 1 |!power| and choose an enemy character within |!range| 2.
The chosen enemy character gains the Bleed special condition. If the chosen character already has the Bleed special condition, that allied character may remove 1 |!damage| from itself instead.

thunderwave.body:
If it is |*Thor, Prince of Asgard|'s activation and he is within |!range| 1 of an allied |*Captain America|, they may spend 1 |!power| each
to play this card.|\|
While within |!range| 1 of |*Captain America|, |*Thor, Prince of Asgard| may use the Thunderwave attack shown above once. |!range| and LOS
are measured from |*Captain America| instead of |*Thor, Prince of Asgard| when making this attack.

till-the-end-of-the-line.body:
|*Winter Soldier| and |*Captain America| may both spend 2 |!power| each to play this card.|\|
While within |!range| 1 of each other this round these characters cannot be moved by enemy effects and combine their defensive
values when creating the defense dice pool when defending against |!physical| or |!energy| attacks.

to-ash-and-cinder.body:
At the start of the |*Activation Phase|, |*Sin| or |*Crossbones| may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Place a |<demolition_charge>Demolition Charge| token within |!range| 3 of this character. During the next |*Cleanup Phase|, all
characters within |!range| 2 of the Demoltion Charge token gain the |§stun§Stun| special condition and then suffer 2 |!damage|. Destroy all
terrain features of size 3 or less within |!range| 2 of the Demolition Charge token, then remove the token from the battlefield.

to-me-my-x-men.body:
A character with an |*Uncanny X-Men| leadership ability may spend any number of |!power| to play this card.|\|
For each 1 |!power| spent to play this card, one allied |*Uncanny X-Men| character may advance |!range_small| toward this character.

tomorrows-soldiers.body:
When an allied |*New Mutants| character is Dazed or KO'd, another allied |*New Mutants| character may play this card.|\|
All non-Dazed allied |*New Mutants| characters gain 2 |!power|.

totem-of-the-tiger-god.body:
During her Activation, |*Tigra| may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
When |*Tigra| targets an enemy character with an attack this Round, she may change the attack's type to |!mystic|.|\|
Additionally, when |*Tigra| deals |!damage| to an enemy character with a |*Feline Slash| attack this Round, after the attack is resolved, |*Tigra| may Place herself within |!range| 2 of her current position.

traitor-to-the-cause.body:
During |*Onslaught|'s Activation, he may spend 4 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Any number of enemy characters within |!range| 2 of |*Onslaught| may spend 2 |!power|. Each enemy character that spent |!power| drops all objective tokens it is holding and Advances Away from |*Onslaught| |!movement_small|. Then |*Onslaught| gains 2 |!power| for each enemy character that spent |!power|. Finally, |*Onslaught| makes the |*Psychic Storm| attack shown above.

trial-by-combat.body:
An allied |*Wakanda| character with an active Leadership ability may play this card during its Activation.|\|
Choose an enemy character with an active Leadership ability within |!range| 3 of the character that played this card. The chosen character and the character that played this card roll dice equal to their remaining Stamina.|\|
The Leadership ability of the character that rolled fewer |!critical|, |!hit|, and |!wild| results becomes inactive for the rest of the Round.

tricksters-boon.body:
During an allied non-|*Asgard| character's Activation, |*Loki, Prince of Lies| may spend 4 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose an allied non-|*Asgard| character and an enemy character. The chosen allied character gains 5 |!power|.|\|
This |*Activation Phase|, if the chosen allied character Dazes or KO's the chosen enemy character, gain 1 VP after the effect is resolved. If it did not, during the |*Cleanup Phase|, the player controlling the chosen enemy character gains 1 VP, the chosen allied character loses all of its |!power| and |*Loki, Prince of Lies| gains 1 |!power| for each |!power| lost this way.

trip-up.body:
When an allied character targets an enemy character with an attack during its activation and the target character is within |!range| 2 of
another allied character, the allied characters may spend 1 |!power| each to play this card.|\|
If the target character is dealt |!damage| by this attack, after the attack is resolved it gains the |§stun§Stun| and |§stagger§Stagger|
special conditions.

trust-no-one-but-yourself.body:
When this card is revealed during |*Deployment|, |*Nathaniel Richards| may play it.|\|
Choose a Round on the Mission Tracker without an allied |<timestream>Timestream| token and put an allied Timestream token on it. Return this card to your available Team Tactic Cards during the first |*Cleanup Phase|. It may be played again this Game.
trust-no-one-but-yourself.secondaryBody:
During the |*Power Phase|, you may remove an allied Timestream token from the current Round. If you do, one or more allied |*Nathaniel Richards| must spend any number of |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose an unused |*Nathaniel Richards| from your Roster with a |!threat| equal to or less than half the amount of |!power| spent (rounding down). Place the chosen character into play within |!range| 1 of an allied |*Nathaniel Richards|. The chosen character gains |!power| equal to the current Round and is now part of your Squad.|\|
At the end of the |*Activation Phase|, if an allied |*Nathaniel Richards| was Placed into play with this card, remove that character from the Battlefield.

two-more-shall-rise.body:
When an allied |*Hydra| character with an active Leadership ability is KO'd, another allied character may play this card.|\|
Choose two allied characters with |*Hydra| or |*Cabal| Leadership abilities. Both chosen characters' Leadership abilities become active.

ultimate-sacrifice.body:
When an allied character within |!range| 2 of an allied |*Angel| is targeted by an enemy attack, |*Angel| may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
|*Angel| becomes the target of the attack regardless of range or LOS. After the attack is resolved, if |*Angel| is Dazed or KO'd, remove up to three |!damage| and all special conditions from the allied character.

under-your-skin.body:
When this card is revealed during |*Deployment|, you may play it.|\|
Choose 1 non-|*Sentinels|-affiliated character in your Squad. When the chosen character is deployed, it gains a |<nanite>Nanite| token and is now a
|*Sentinels|-affiliated character.|\|
A character with a Nanite token gains the |*Flight| and |*Immunity [Poison, Bleed]| |!innate| superpowers.

unearthly-rage.body:
During a character's activation, it may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
This activation, if the character is within |!range| 2 of two or more enemy characters while making its next attack,
add 2 dice to the attack roll.

uneasy-allies.body:
During their activation, when |*Spider-Man| or |*Venom| targets an enemy character with an attack that is within |!range| 2 of
the other allied character, both characters may suffer 1 |!damage| to play this card.|\|
Add 3 dice to the attack roll.

untapped-potential.body:
If it is |*Iceman|'s Activation, |*Emma Frost| may play this card.|\|
During this Activation, superpowers and attacks used by |*Iceman| may spend |!power| from either |*Iceman| or |*Emma Frost|.
Attacks made by |*Iceman| this Activation add 1 die to their attack rolls.|\|
Additionally, during this Activation, |*Iceman| may use superpowers on his Stat Card
any number of times, even if they say they can be used only once.

up-the-ante.body:
When another allied character would deal |!damage| to an enemy character with an attack, an allied |*Mephisto, Lord of Temptation| may play this card. The enemy character's controlling player chooses one of the following effects:|\|
|~The attack does not deal &!damage& and the enemy character loses that much &!power& instead. For the remainder of the game, &*Mephisto, Lord of Temptation& may have up to 5 &<devils_deal>Devil's Deal& tokens instead of the normal 3. Then, &*Mephisto, Lord of Temptation& gains 2 Devil's Deal tokens.|
|~After the attack is resolved, &*Mephisto, Lord of Temptation& may remove an Activated token from himself. If he does not, return this cards to your available Team Tactic cards instead of discarding it, and this card may be played again this game.|

usurp-the-throne.body:
|*Killmonger| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
This round, |*Killmonger| adds two dice to his attack rolls when attacking the enemy character with the highest
threat value. If |*Killmonger| Dazes or KOs that character this round, his controlling player scores 2VPs.|\|
If there is a tie for highest threat value, Killmonger's controller chooses one to be affected by this card.

vapors-of-valtorr.body:
If there are 2 other non-Dazed allied characters within |!range| 2 of |*Doctor Strange|, he may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose a character within |!range| 3 of |*Doctor Strange|. The chosen character gains 3 |<obscuring_mist>Obscuring Mist| tokens. Each time the chosen
character is targeted by an attack, shuffle the tokens and reveal 1 at random. If the token has a blank on the back, |*Doctor Strange| may
reroll any number of the attacker’s dice. If it has a silhouette, the attack continues as normal.
At the end of the Round, remove all Obscuring Mist tokens from the chosen character.

vendetta.body:
When an allied character is Dazed or KO'd by an enemy effect, an allied |*Elektra| may play this card.|\|
Mark the enemy character that caused the effect with a |<vendetta>Vendetta| token. The next attack made
by |*Elektra| targeting the character with the Vendetta token adds 3 dice to its attack roll. After the attack
is resolved, remove the Vendetta token.

venomized.body:
An allied character may spend 3 |!power| to play this card during its Activation.|\|
For the rest of the game, the character that played this card lowers its |!energy| defense stat by 2, to a minimum of 1.|\|
For the rest of the game, the character that played this card gains the attack shown above.

attacks.name: We Are Hungry
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character removes 1 |!damage| from itself for each |!damage| dealt.

versatile-strategy.body:
An allied character without an active Leadership ability may play this card.|\|
You may choose a non-active Leadership ability of an allied character in your squad that corresponds to your
Squad Affiliation. The chosen Leadership ability is now active and all other Leadership abilities for that squad are no longer active.
All effects of any previous Leadership abilities expire.

vertical-assistance.body:
During |*Natasha Romanoff|'s Activation she may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose an allied character within |!range| 3 of |*Natasha Romanoff|. The chosen character gains the |*Wall Crawler| |!innate| superpower
until the end of the Round. It immediately Advances |!movement_small|.

veterans-of-the-annihilation-war.body:
During the |*Power Phase|, an allied |*Gamora| and an allied |*Richard Rider| may play this card.|\|
This Round, |*Gamora| gains the following superpower:
veterans-of-the-annihilation-war.intermediaryBody: This Round, |*Richard Rider| gains the following superpower:

superPowers.body: When this character makes an attack, if there are 1 or more |!wild| results in the attack roll, it may change 1 die result to a |!hit|.

|*Black Panther| or |*Shuri| may spend X |!power| to play this card. X must be at least 1 and no more than 5.|\|
|<vibranium_shielding>This round|, this character and allied characters while they are within |!range| X of this character,
gain the Invulnerability Innate superpower. X is equal to the amount of |!power| spent to play this card.

superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.

victory-assured.body:
During an allied Johann Schmidt's activation, he may suffer up to 5 |!damage| to play this card.
This character may use the attack shown above once this activation.

steps: If this attack Dazes or KO's the target character, this character gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.
When making this attack, add attack dice to each attack roll equal to the |!damage| suffered to play this card.

wakanda-forever.body:
Any number of allied |*Wakanda| characters may spend 1 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Each character that spent |!power| may immediately perform an attack with a |!power| cost of 0.

wand-of-watoomb.body:
A |*Convocation| character may spend 2 |!power| during its activation to play this card.|\|
|<wand_of_watoomb>Choose one of the following effects|:
|~ This character may use the Elemental Blast attack listed above once this activation.||\|
|~ This character may reroll 2 dice in its defense rolls this round.||\|
|~ This character may use a superpower that is normally limited to once per turn a second time this activation, paying all costs as normal.|

steps: |!wild| |*Elemental Blast|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate|, |§shock§Shock|, and |§slow§Slow| special conditions.

warpath.body:
After an attack that damaged an allied character is resolved, the damaged character may spend 1 |!power| to play
this card.|\|
This character may advance |!range_small| toward the attacking character.

warriors-frenzy.body:
When |*Valkyrie and Elendil| Dazes or KO‘s an enemy character with an attack during their Activation, after that attack is resolved, |*Valkyrie and Elendil| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
This character may Advance |!movement_small|. Then this character may choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of |!size| 3 or less and within |!range| 2, and Throw it |!movement_medium|.

warriors-oath.body:
When another allied |*Asgard| character attacks an enemy character, after the attack is resolved, an allied |*Warriors Three| within |!range| 3 of that allied character may spend 2-6 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Place |*Warriors Three| within |!range| 1 of that allied character. Then, for each 2 |!power| paid to play this card, choose a different effect below to resolve. Completely resolve each effect before moving to the next.|\|
|*Fandral‘s Biting Wit|: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 2 of |*Warriors Three|. It gains the Shock and Stun special conditions.|\|
|*Hogun‘s Elixir of Recovery|: Choose an allied character within |!range| 2 of |*Warriors Three|. Remove up to 2 |!damage| from the chosen character.|\|
|*Volstagg‘s Courage|: Choose up to 2 other allied character within |!range| 2 of |*Warriors Three|. Each chosen character gains 1 |!power|.

we-are-groot.body:
|*Groot| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
|*Groot| and allied characters within |!range| 4 of him remove 2 |!damage|.

weapon-x-program.body:
|*Wolverine| or |*Sabretooth| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
This character is thrown |!range_small|. It does not suffer damage if it collides with another character
or terrain feature.

weapons-of-midgard.body:
During |*Skurge, the Executioner|'s Activation, he may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
|*Skurge, the Executioner| makes the |*Destroy| attack shown above.

weapons-stash.body:
|*Maverick| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Choose a Secure objective token within |!range| 3 of |*Maverick| and place a |<stash>Stash| token within |!range| 1 of it.
While within |!range| 1 of the Stash token, allied characters gain Cover from enemy attacks.|\|
Additionally, allied characters gain the following |*Interact| ability:|\|
|*Interact (Stash token)|: Remove this token from the battlefield. This character adds 2 dice to its next attack this Activation.

web-barrier.body:
Two |*Web Warriors| characters may both spend 1 |!power| to play this card.|\|
While these characters are within |!range| 3 of each other this round they cannot be pushed, thrown,
or placed by enemy effects and while advancing enemy characters cannot place a movement tool that would
overlap either allied character, or a straight line drawn between these characters unless they are Climbing.
Characters cannot draw Line of Sight through these characters or a straight line drawn between them |<web_barrier>this round|.

web-of-the-spider-verse.body:
After Deployment, an allied |*Web Warriors| character may play this card. When this card is played, set it near the battlefield instead of discarding it.|\|
While your Squad does not have an active Leadership ability, allied |*Web Warriors| characters gain the |*Into the Spider-verse| superpower.

superPowers.body: When this character attacks, defends, or dodges, after the effect is resolved, if its roll contained 1 or more |!failure| results, this character may Place itself within |!range| 1 of its current position.

well-laid-plans.body:
|*Green Goblin| and |*Doctor Octopus| may spend 3 |!power| each to play this card.|\|
Roll 5 dice for each enemy character holding an objective token. The enemy character suffers one damage
for each |!critical| and |!wild| result rolled.|\|
A character damaged in this way drops all objective tokens it is holding. The player playing this card
chooses the order in which enemy characters are affected.

winter-rush.body:
During the Power Phase, any number of allied |*Winter Guard| characters may spend any number of |!power| to
play this card.|\|
If 6 or more |!power| was spent to play this card, each time an allied character is damaged by an enemy effect
this round, after the effect is resolved, another allied |*Winter Guard| character may advance |!range_small|
toward the enemy character that caused the effect.

wisdom-of-the-ancestors.body:
|*T‘Challa| or |*Shuri| may spend 3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
This Round, when the character that played this card rolls attack, defense, or dodge dice, it counts |!failure| results in its roll as successes.

wolverines.body:
|*James Logan Howlett| and |*Laura Kinney| may spend 3 |!power| each to play this card.|\|
While |*James Logan Howlett| and |*Laura Kinney| are within |!range| 2 of each other, they cannot be pushed
or thrown by enemy effects, they may reroll any number of attack dice, and after an attack targeting either
of them is resolved, the attacking character suffers 1 |!damage| if it did not Daze or KO the target
  character. This effect lasts until the end of the round.

world-domination.body:
If you are Securing all Secure Objective tokens, an allied |*Hydra| character may play this card.|\|
You gain 1 VP for every 2 Secure Objective tokens you are Securing. Additionally, each character you control
gains 1 |!power| for every 2 Secure Objective tokens you are Securing.

x-ceptional-healing.body:
When an allied character with the |*Healing Factor| superpower would be damaged by an enemy effect, it may spend
3 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Reduce the amount of damage suffered to 1.

During the |*Power Phase|, |*Onslaught| may spend 2 |!power| to play this card.|\|
Until the end of this Round, when |*Onslaught| is attacking or defending, the enemy character cannot modify its dice.

number of other allied characters may each

the amount of |!damage| the allied character would

Select |*ONE| of the following effects:

|~ If an allied &*Domino& is within &!range& 2 of &*Deadpool&, &*Deadpool& may use the Grenade Bounce attack listed on her stat card once this activation without paying its Power cost.||\|

you-will-do-as-i-say-monster.body:
During |*George Tarleton|'s Activation, if he is within |!range| 2 of an allied |*Abomination|, he may spend 4 |!power| to play this card.|\|
|*George Tarleton| Throws the allied |*Abomination| |!movement_medium|.
